en.headline: RTHK launches new media platform and mascot
en.dek: The broadcaster said the platform and an AI-generated mascot follow a Policy Address pledge, and that schools may use a new education corner free of charge.
body: Radio Television Hong Kong on Monday launched a new media platform and an artificial-intelligence-generated mascot named Din Din, which the station said is meant to carry out a 2026 Policy Address pledge to use AI and new platforms in its production.

The Director of Broadcasting said the station hopes the platform and mascot will feel more approachable and draw a wider audience, especially younger viewers and listeners. The government information note said the mascot's design refers to the electromagnetic waves used in radio and television, and to RTHK's broadcasting history.

The station said the platform is organised around five strands: community stories, lighter explainers, guides to local events, sights and food, archive material restored with AI and shown against newer footage, and online short dramas to be released later using a mix of AI, animation and live action.

RTHK also opened an online education resource corner listing more than ten selected programmes on education and youth themes. The station said schools are authorised to play them on campus and use them in teaching without charge.

zh.headline: 港台推出新媒體平台和吉祥物「電電」
zh.dek: 港台說平台和人工智能吉祥物落實施政報告的相關表述，並向學校免費授權十多套教育及青年節目作教學播放。
body: 香港電台星期一推出新媒體平台，以及以人工智能技術生成的吉祥物「電電」。政府新聞稿說，這是為落實2026年施政報告中支持港台加強使用人工智能和新媒體平台的表述。
廣播處長關婉儀表示，港台希望藉平台和吉祥物增添活力和親和力，吸引更廣泛、尤其是年輕觀眾和聽眾。新聞稿說，「電電」的設計意念來自電台和電視服務所依賴的電磁波，並代表港台的廣播歷史。
港台說，平台內容分五大主題：《Wa～好香港》深入社區找故事；《Wa～好識答》以較輕鬆方式介紹香港；《Wa～好去處》向市民和旅客介紹活動、景點和美食；《Wa～好經典》用人工智能修復舊檔案，並以新舊對比呈現城市發展；《Wa～好好戲》則稍後推出，以人工智能、動漫、真人和混合手法製作網上短劇。
港台同時推出網上教育資源中心，臚列十多套以教育及青年為題材的精選節目，並免費授權學校在校播放和作教學用途。
